# Step - as_bool

`as_bool` · `asBool` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts the value to a boolean: true/false strings in any case, numbers (0 is false); anything else is an error unless a CastPolicy says otherwise.

## Forms

```text
as_bool()
as_bool(arg1: CastPolicy)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("true", "FALSE", 0).as_bool().to_list()   // [true, false, false]
```

## See also

- [Type Conversion](../../users_guide/type_conversion.md)
